newsitem.title: USA: Williams system gasoline,diesel inventories topped.
newsitem.headline: Williams system gasoline,diesel inventories topped.

text.p: The Williams Pipeline Co has held shippers to maximum allocations on shipments through the system as gasoline and diesel inventory levels topped out in the Midwest, a spokesman for the Williams Cos unit said on Monday.

The Tulsa, Okla.-based pipeline system reported 1.36 million barrels of high sulphur diesel, 6.63 million barrels of N-grade 87 octane gasoline and 753,000 barrels of premium unleaded gasoline in its system.
"Premium is the main concern because it is the slowest mover," Jim Regnery, Williams shipping services manager, told Reuters.

Traders in the Midwest spot markets said differentials were under downward pressure in Group Three and could eventually ease in Chicago if refined products are diverted north because of the high inventory levels in the Williams system.

The Williams system carries refined product from regional refiners as well as product brought to the lower Midwest from Gulf Coast refineries on the Explorer pipeline system, which continues north to Chicago.
